verdict.rationale: A live probe found HMRC running a versioned production REST API platform for Making Tax Digital, and the gov.uk pages say filing goes through third-party software that works with Making Tax Digital, so programmatic driving is real. However, the developer hub's API documentation was not read (robots.txt disallows crawlers), so coverage, endpoints, and auth flows are unconfirmed. missing for 10: direct evidence of the published API reference docs, endpoint/scope coverage beyond MTD, the auth/onboarding model for developers, and hands-on corroboration of a successful authenticated call.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: a live, versioned production REST platform (Making Tax Digital) answering with a structured error contract
